title: FinGuard: Multi-Tenant Loan & Credit Risk System
tagline: Enterprise loan management with real-time XGBoost credit risk scoring and SHAP factor analysis.
description: Multi-tenant PERN stack loan platform with an applied ML credit-risk microservice built on FastAPI. Integrates an XGBoost classification pipeline evaluated with cost-weighted thresholding and SHAP explainability.

title: AI Lyric & Next-Word Generator (PyTorch LSTM)
tagline: PyTorch LSTM language model trained on song lyrics for sequence prediction and lyric generation.
description: A PyTorch-based LSTM language model trained on song lyrics (lyric_dataset.txt) that performs next-word prediction and lyric generation by continuing user-provided text prompts. Features tokenization, learned word embeddings, and a FastAPI inference server.

title: DataSphere: Structured Data Intelligence
tagline: Automated spreadsheet ingestion, natural language querying, and dynamic data visualizer.
description: Ingests spreadsheets and CSV files into PostgreSQL, supports CRUD operations through a clean UI, provides natural language querying capabilities, and renders lightweight, instant data visualizations.

title: ExpendWise: Predictive Expense Management
tagline: Smart expense tracking system with automated spending category prediction.
description: Personal finance management application that aggregates transactions and leverages predictive models to forecast upcoming monthly spending, detect anomalies, and suggest budget optimizations.

title: Biometric Face Attendance System
tagline: High-accuracy facial recognition attendance pipeline with optimized database queries.
description: Full-stack biometric attendance system using PHP, FastAPI, MySQL, Haar Cascade, and Random Forest classifier. Engineered database indexing and image preprocessing achieving 95% recognition accuracy with optimized query execution.
metrics: Indexed SQL schema for lower latency

title: Lexical Duplicate Question Detector
tagline: NLP duplicate question classifier with token features and fuzzy substring ratios.
description: Streamlit NLP classifier using Random Forest and XGBoost with token features, substring ratios, and fuzzy string matching to detect semantically duplicate queries with 72% accuracy.

title: DigitalMandu: Multi-Vendor Marketplace
tagline: Multi-vendor food delivery and e-commerce infrastructure.
description: Multi-vendor delivery platform in the style of modern delivery applications featuring cart management, role-based store controls, live order tracking, and clean checkout workflows.

title: Chatopia: Real-Time Collaborative Messaging
tagline: Real-time WebSocket chat application supporting 100+ concurrent sessions.
description: MERN and WebSocket chat application supporting 100+ concurrent users with JWT authentication, instant message broadcasting, active status indicators, and Zustand client state management.

title: Falodhyam Agricultural E-Commerce
tagline: Agricultural trade portal with catalog, wishlist, and inventory tracking.
description: Full-featured agricultural commerce platform with role-based access, automated stock inventory management, cart workflows, and responsive customer interface.
